actual_scope: Realize both PR3378 pooled integer inventories in the exact selected T16 time windows, retaining whole helper widths, 144 literal call inventories and 32256 disjoint bins while relaxing family/pair and all physical conditions.
scope_change_reason: The handoff asks which timing/family restrictions tighten the pooled optimum. This isolates timing first. Two exact temporal witnesses distinguish window feasibility from the still-open family-compatible physical attainment problem.
bottleneck_link: The complex side binds. This proves that call-window eligibility alone cannot tighten the sharp pooled packing cap; a stronger obstruction must retain additional family/pair or physical structure.
stop_rule: Stop after the two fixed integer profiles and exact selected call windows. No modified chronology, physical owner search, full supplier replay or wider exponent census.
evidence: CERTIFICATE.json: exact pattern allocations and time/width flows. RESULT.json: both 69120-row expansions match exact source helper identities, windows, disjoint capacities and attaining idle histograms. Seven behavioral groups cover semantic/source corruptions.
